rows.label: The Second Dream, then the Pluto junction
rows.note: unlocks The War Within in the Codex; no Mastery Rank gate since Update 35.0

rows.label: The War Within
rows.note: Teshin's inbox message delivers the built Broken Scepter with a free slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst

conditions: The quest can drop you back at the mountain pass on completion. Kill the client completely, restart at the quest's opening and redo it; different dialogue options on the retry also helped.
A replay does not give a second Scepter, and Operator abilities, Tauron Strikes and Tekolyst mods are disabled on replay.
Rank it to 30 for Mastery. Equipping needs Mastery Rank 7.
bonuses: The same inbox message carries an Orvius blueprint, a Riven mod and a Personal Quarters blueprint.

disclosures.title: a second copy
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells the Broken Scepter Blueprint for 100,000 Standing once the quest is done. The build is 25,000 credits, 5,000 Kuva, 2 Morphics, 300 Rubedo and 2,500 Salvage, 1 day. Mastery counts once, so this is only for a spare.

disclosures.title: fast Simaris standing
disclosures.body: Scan from out of enemy sight on a Steel Path open world (Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis or Cambion Drift), in Archwing at about 130-150m with enemy highlighting on; stealth scans triple the standing and people report the daily cap in 3-5 minutes. Orb Vallis' Temple of Profit has the densest respawning cluster. Turn the daily Synthesis target in last: its standing (about 2,500) is not counted against the cap. The cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, and turning in at the 125,000 standing cap wastes the reward. The Sol Battery widget removes scanner-charge limits; Synthesis Scanners otherwise cost 5,000 credits for 25 charges.

disclosures.title: Kuva for the spare
disclosures.body: Kuva Flood missions (level 80-100) pay roughly 1,100-1,400 each, or run the Kuva Survival on Taveuni. Teshin (Steel Essence), Acrithis and Nightcap also sell it weekly.
